title: schema-for-ai: JSON-LD templates tuned for AI extraction and citation
description:
Copy-paste JSON-LD templates tuned for how AI assistants extract and cite information. Structured data helps ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI resolve what a product is and pull clean facts into answers.

Includes a dependency-free Python validator. Python standard library only.

Note: structured data is published here for machine-readability and general good practice. We make no claim that it increases the likelihood of citation by an AI answer engine — the one controlled study on that question found a null result once ranking position was controlled for.
